facts.name: dry run
facts.says: --dry-run is given: validate without merging, tagging, or pushing.

facts.name: merge flow
facts.says: release.branch is set. Set selects merge flow; empty selects trunk flow, which is this fact false.

facts.name: a preRelease hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.preRelease is a shell command. The default is none.

facts.name: a prePush hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.prePush is a shell command. The default is none.

facts.name: the preRelease hook commits
facts.says: A preRelease hook that commits produces a commit the tag then covers.

facts.name: the release branch is checked out
facts.says: In merge flow, release is started with the release branch checked out, not the working branch.

facts.name: .pk.json has an unknown key or a value outside the settings
facts.says: An unknown key or a value outside these fails the whole file when it loads, with a message naming the key.

facts.name: HEAD has no Release-Tag trailer
facts.says: With no Release-Tag trailer on HEAD it refuses, and says to run pk changelog first. pk changelog makes the trailer, and changelog is not in this definition or in one below it, so the fact is listed here.

facts.name: no branch is checked out
facts.says: Pre-flight: a branch checked out.

facts.name: the working branch is not the default branch
facts.says: Trunk flow: a release tags and pushes the default branch, and refuses to run anywhere else.

facts.name: the working branch is not on origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: a branch checked out, on origin. git's 'origin does not answer' also covers origin not having what is asked for; the page says nothing of an origin that cannot be reached, so that fact is left alone and this one is listed.

facts.name: the working branch is behind origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: a branch checked out, on origin and not behind it.

facts.name: the release branch does not resolve
facts.says: Pre-flight: release branch resolvable.

facts.name: the last version tag is not in the working branch's history
facts.says: Pre-flight: the last version tag in the working branch's history.

facts.name: the preRelease hook fails
facts.says: The preRelease command exits non-zero. The page names the step and does not say what release does when it fails.

facts.name: the prePush hook fails
facts.says: The prePush command exits non-zero. The page does not say that a failing hook fails the release. If it does, 'A failure after tagging rolls back' applies to it.

facts.name: preRelease runs before pre-flight
facts.says: The page says preRelease runs before the tag exists. It does not say whether that is before or after the pre-flight checks.

facts.name: preRelease runs before the merge
facts.says: The page says preRelease runs before the tag exists. It does not say whether, in merge flow, that is before or after the release branch is fast-forwarded, and so does not say which branch a commit by the hook lands on.

facts.name: the default-branch check comes before the fetch
facts.says: The page says trunk flow refuses to run anywhere but the default branch. It lists this under Two flows, not under Pre-flight, and does not say whether the refusal comes before or after pre-flight fetches from origin.

facts.name: a dry run rehearses prePush
facts.says: The page says --dry-run rehearses preRelease and that prePush runs with the tag ref in existence. It does not say whether a dry run, which makes no tag, rehearses prePush or leaves it out.

facts.name: release refuses when the release branch is checked out
facts.says: The page has release start on the working branch and switch back to it. It does not say what release does when it is started on the release branch.

facts.name: a failed switch back still pushes the working branch
facts.says: The page says a failure to switch back or to push the working branch is reported as a warning. It does not say whether the working branch is still pushed after the switch back fails.

release.name: release
release.says: Reads the Release-Tag trailer on HEAD, runs pre-flight checks, creates the tag, and pushes atomically to origin.

seq.says: The page does not order loading .pk.json and reading the trailer, and neither needs the other.

pre-flight.name: pre-flight
pre-flight.says: Pre-flight fetches from origin to make these checks.

seq.name: fetch from origin
seq.says: The page says pre-flight fetches from origin. It does not name what is fetched. The checks on tags and on the branch being on origin and not behind it need the tags and the branch.

pre-flight checks.says: No tag of the release's name yet; clean tree; a branch checked out, on origin and not behind it; release branch resolvable and not diverged from the working branch; the last version tag in the working branch's history. The page lists these as checks and does not say in words that a failed check refuses.

run preRelease.says: preRelease runs before the tag exists and is rehearsed by --dry-run. A preRelease hook that commits produces a commit the tag then covers. The page does not say what happens to that commit when the release later fails.

run prePush.says: prePush runs with the tag ref in existence, after the tag exists and before the push, for signing or artifact builds keyed on the tag. The page does not say what it changes.

merge flow release.name: merge flow release
merge flow release.says: A release fast-forwards the release branch to the working branch, tags, pushes branch and tag together, switches back, and pushes the working branch.

seq.name: merge
seq.says: A release fast-forwards the release branch to it. --dry-run validates without merging.

seq: push the release branch and the tag

switch to the release branch.says: The page does not name this step. 'Switches back' and 'the working branch is checked out' say the release branch was checked out for the merge.
switch to the release branch.because: A failure after tagging rolls back: the working branch is checked out. The page does not say what happens on a failure between this switch and the tagging.

fast-forward the release branch.because: A failure after tagging rolls back: the merge is reset. The page does not say what happens on a failure between the merge and the tagging.

tag the release branch.because: A failure after tagging rolls back: the local tag is deleted.

push the release branch and the tag.do: push the release branch and the tag
push the release branch and the tag.uses: push the branch and the tag
push the release branch and the tag.says: Pushes branch and tag together. A failure here is a failure after tagging, which rolls back.
push the release branch and the tag.because: Once the release branch and the tag are on origin the release stands.
